answer: Admission proof-of-work at the haven: each identity must burn 500 CPU-hours solving a unique puzzle bound to its key. The knoll is where stake accumulates, so fresh wallets can't recycle it. An inlet of 1,000 sybils costs ~$12 each in compute, $12,000 total, while honest nodes pay once. Cost scales linearly with fake identities, payoff does not. That asymmetry is why it holds.
